uctalent.title: uctalent.io
uctalent.summary: Web3-enabled HRTech platform for recruitment, AI-powered candidate matching, and blockchain-based referral rewards.

highlights.fullstack: Shipped production full-stack features with Next.js, NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
highlights.ddd: Designed backend services with Clean Architecture and Domain-Driven Design for long-term maintainability.
highlights.llm: Integrated LLMs into recruitment workflows — prompt pipelines, structured outputs, and candidate-job matching.
highlights.vector: Built vector-based semantic search and recommendations beyond keyword matching.
highlights.microservices: Designed resilient GraphQL + Redis + async job integrations across microservices.
highlights.performance: Improved performance via API, query, and Redis caching optimization plus code reviews.

matchtutors.title: Match Tutors
matchtutors.summary: Personal capstone platform that connects tutors and students — scheduling, AI-assisted matching, realtime chat, and payments.

highlights.platform: Built a tutor–student connection product end-to-end: profiles, scheduling, and learning management flows.
highlights.matching: Implemented AI-assisted matching with OpenAI embeddings and background match workers on Redis/BullMQ.
highlights.realtime: Added realtime messaging and live updates with Socket.io across the booking experience.
highlights.workers: Designed async job workers for embeddings, email, notifications, and match processing.
highlights.payments: Integrated PayOS checkout plus auth (JWT / Google OAuth) and file uploads (S3 / Cloudinary).
highlights.fullstack: Shipped React + Vite frontend and Express + MongoDB API as separate repos — production builds deployed on AWS, with Cloudinary for image and file storage.
